title: Can Coding Agents Write and Transpile Unit Tests
abstract: arXiv:2611.21797v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding assistants built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a staple of modern software development, increasingly trusted to execute workflows and modernize code end-to-end. Much of this trust rests on passing tests, which are often written by the coding agents themselves. In this work, we examine the ability of these agents to both write reliable tests and translate them between programming languages. We benchmark three popular coding agents, each evaluated with a native frontier model and high reasoning effort. Verifying across a broad suite of metrics, we find that coding agents far exceed human written suites on traditional measures of coverage. This advantage, however, is uneven: agent test quality degrades sharply with project size, and much of the advantage lies in a greater number of written tests. We also show that agentic test translation---while seemingly strong in aggregate---remains inconsistent and unreliable.

translated_title: 编程智能体能否编写和转译单元测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的编程助手已成为现代软件开发的重要组成部分，人们越来越信任它们端到端地执行工作流程和改造现代化代码。这种信任很大程度上建立在测试通过的基础上，而这些测试往往是由编程智能体自己编写的。在这项工作中，我们检验了这些智能体编写可靠测试以及在编程语言之间转换测试的能力。我们对三个流行的编程智能体进行了基准测试，每个都使用原生前沿模型和高推理强度进行评估。通过广泛的指标验证，我们发现编程智能体在传统覆盖率指标上远超人类编写的测试套件。然而，这一优势并不均衡：智能体的测试质量随项目规模增大而急剧下降，且其优势很大程度上源于编写了更多的测试数量。我们还表明，智能体测试翻译虽然在总体上看起来表现强劲，但仍然不一致且不可靠。
tldr: 本研究对三个编程智能体进行了基准测试，发现其编写的单元测试在覆盖率上远超人类测试套件，但测试质量随项目规模增大而急剧下降，且跨语言测试翻译仍不一致且不可靠。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks three coding agents, finding that their unit tests far exceed human-written suites in coverage, yet test quality degrades sharply with project size and agentic test translation remains inconsistent and unreliable.
